facts.fact: 全书开场：Eden 告别农场全家返城，说这是最难的事，读到大四仍没习惯。
facts.anchor: Saying goodbye to my family is always the hardest thing to do.

facts.fact: Eden 是五个孩子里的老大、唯一离巢进城的人，告别要按「月」计。
facts.anchor: Being the eldest of five kids—and the only one who has flown the nest

facts.fact: 弟弟 Jake 十三岁就比她高（6'5"），从此拿她当头枕。
facts.anchor: Not my proudest day when at thirteen he realised he had a few inches over me

facts.fact: 第一年修 Contemporary Literature 直接挂科，这是重修的原因。
facts.anchor: Ending that subject with a failure was not my happiest moment

facts.fact: 利害链：挂科→丢 post-grad→丢 PhD offer，她自称「没活头」。
facts.anchor: And if I lose my PhD offer, I basically don’t have a reason to live.

facts.fact: Gemma 的姐姐 Misty 读完教职留下，当上学生宿舍主管。
facts.anchor: taking over as head of student accommodation

facts.fact: Gemma 念出的家教名单（三人），随后才是 Oliver James。
facts.anchor: Cory Donovan, Heath Carson, Jamil Sutherland

facts.fact: Oliver 的档案：二十岁、五星评分、绿眼睛棕卷发。
facts.anchor: Twenty years old. Perfect five star rating!

facts.fact: Eden 答应后 Gemma 抢回手机、以她的名义发出咨询。
facts.anchor: she snatches her phone back and sends an inquiry in my name
